patterns.note: Content is consistently centered within a maximum width, allowing for generous white space around sections and large, illustrative visuals.
Key words within large, bold sans-serif headings are highlighted with brightly colored, rounded background 'pills' that resemble emojis, adding a playful emphasis.

A stark black-on-white base is consistently used, with vibrant, saturated accent colors (blue, orange, green, red) reserved exclusively for the animated text highlights and occasional small graphic elements.
Specific keywords within headings feature a continuous, subtle glowing animation on their colored background, drawing attention and adding a dynamic, playful feel.
The header bar subtly reduces in height and maintains its fixed position at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page.
Each major content section introduces a core benefit or feature with a prominent, bold heading, followed by a concise description and a large, illustrative visual or diagram.

technique_notes: The header transitions to a more compact state upon scrolling, reducing its vertical height while remaining fixed at the top of the viewport.
Content sections are introduced with a scroll-triggered animation, appearing to slide up and fade into view as the user scrolls down the page.

Specific keywords within headings are visually emphasized with a solid, brightly colored background and a subtle, continuous glow animation, making them stand out like interactive emojis, achieved using css-keyframes.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold headings (~3-4x body text) create strong hierarchy, contrasted with smaller, highly readable body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are used for buttons and the distinctive highlighted text elements, while most other elements maintain sharp edges.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a clean, uncluttered feel.

standout: The most distinctive design element is the playful yet bold use of brightly colored, glowing, emoji-like highlights on key words within otherwise minimal, large headings. This unique treatment injects personality and draws attention without compromising the site's clean aesthetic.
